[module]
name = task
type = static
version = 0.1.0

[build]
unity_build = false

# The trusted Luau framework ships inside the binary. scripts/embed_luau.py
# turns every .luau under this directory into one generated translation unit in
# the build tree, carrying the source bytes, a per-file SHA-256, a bundle hash,
# and the version below. The generated file is never committed.
[embed]
luau_directory = runtime
luau_version = 0.1.0

# image is private because it appears in no header of this module: only
# pixel-probe.cpp and task-context.cpp reach it, to decode the PNG blob `probe`
# measures and to encode the one `cycle_crop` produces. Both verbs exist for the
# exploration front-end (docs/plans/2026-08-01-agent-front-end-and-exploration.md
# 1); the bytes cross this boundary as bytes, so nothing image declares is named
# by anything task publishes.
[dependencies]
public = core domain engine script trace
private = image Luau.VM Luau.Compiler Luau.Ast
